facts.fact: 日记开篇断言中情局真正的动力源是酒精，并叫读者自己去总部验证
facts.anchor: America’s Central Intelligence Agency runs on alcohol.

facts.fact: 叙述者报出此刻总部存有 1,357,582.75 加仑可饮用酒精这个精确数字
facts.anchor: there are 1,357,582.75 gallons of potable alcohol at CIA

facts.fact: 拉美处有一台自己的玛格丽特调酒机，周五 Vespers 时一直开到没人能安全操作
facts.anchor: Latin America Division even has its own Margarita machine

facts.fact: 人事处暗门后有一间叫「盲猪」的地下酒吧，付五美元看宠物猪可换一杯免费 Southside
facts.anchor: their own speakeasy called “The Blind Pig.”

facts.fact: 安保处的摩门教徒贴出禁止在总部持有敞口酒瓶的告示，爱尔兰天主教黑手党把它摘下来当纪念品
facts.anchor: putting up signs forbidding open containers at Headquarters

facts.fact: 农场训练点（Camp Swampy）专门收最不可救药的醉鬼，让他们教新任办案官喝酒
facts.anchor: Camp Swampy is where the Agency sends her most incorrigible, staggering, washed-out drunks

facts.fact: 教官「疯杰克」以背诵 Lagavulin 酒标段落作为抓捕科目的评分条件，KRAY 照背了
facts.anchor: made KRAY memorize a passage from the label of Lagavulin’s bottle

facts.fact: 叙述者说真正让人想喝酒的痛苦，是意识到自己上班的地方是个巨大的骗局
facts.anchor: realizing the place where you work is one huge, immense, gigantic fraud
